channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.0).

item.title: [+1] From luxury cars to SUVs: India opens new import window for British vehicles under trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 4 reports from Hindustan Times, Vinetur, Zee Business and 1 more. Related: “Mexico opens talks with India to cut the 150% tariff on tequila”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 5 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India’s economy likely to grow 7.3% in Q2 FY27: Finance Ministry
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 2 reports from DD News. Related: “India’s industrial output remains firm in July as manufacturing, electricity sectors post gains”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India surpasses combined steel production of the US & Japan; Records remarkable rise in global rankings
item.description:
Signal: higher metal prices. 3 reports from DD News, TradingView, Organiser. Related: “Core sector grows 2.3% in February; cement, steel lead expansion”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Input costs rise

Why it matters: Rising metal prices lift Indian steel, aluminium and zinc producers while raising input costs for automakers, builders and capital-goods makers.

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
